findings.evidence: Both sources compile; the baseline assignment implementation returns an error when the selected key is absent. Compilation success alone is not execution qualification.
findings.next_work: Implement and verify ordinary new-key insertion with complete key/value candidate admission and cardinality checks.

findings.evidence: Typed {:} compiles. {} denotes a set and its rejection is not a map compiler defect.
key ∈ map is rejected because the current operator resolves set/element-of. Existing key-set projection can express presence; a direct map lookup/presence API is a separate general-library question.
An explicit Mech state machine calling a mutable-local increment helper is rejected by the pure maintained control-block gate.
findings.next_work: Provide a general pure map-entry insertion/update operation; retain the counting loop and count increment in Mech.

findings.evidence: MapValue currently stores canonical ordered entries. The source-level map type does not promise hashing.
findings.next_work: Express any required hash-table implementation through a general map-library contract, and bind native lowering to it. Preserve ordinary abstract-map optimization.

additional_baseline_gap.evidence: Constructing an empty map with Dynamic cardinality upper_bound=0 is refused during ValueCell initialization as current=1, before assignment executes. The map-insertion limit test therefore also exercises the supported bounded-one representation with an existing entry.
additional_baseline_gap.scope: Separate unresolved initialization/accounting issue; not claimed fixed by insertion support.
